name: Agentic Finance Report and Index
description: The Agentic Finance Report (industry report, edition 1.0, 2026) and the Agentic Finance Index, a free register of agentic-finance deployments and the Open Mandate documents agents run under. Read-only, static, unauthenticated.

skills.name: Read the Agentic Finance Report
skills.description: Summary and full text of the report in Markdown, with printed page markers and numbered sources. Published 29 September 2026.
examples: What does the report say has to be true before an agent acts?

skills.name: Query the Agentic Finance Index
skills.description: List agentic-finance deployments and infrastructure by layer and status, with source and operator confirmation for each entry.
examples: Which identity layers for agents are in production?

skills.name: Validate or fetch an Open Mandate
skills.description: JSON Schema for machine-readable agent mandates and the declared mandates on file.
examples: Fetch OM-0001 and check it against the schema.
